cards.text:
When Revealed: Attach to Kingpin. You are confused. Hero Action: Discard an [[Attack]] event from your hand → discard Vanessa Fisk. Kingpin attacks you.
[star] Boost: You are confused. If you were already confused, place 1 threat on the main scheme.

cards.name: Black Cat
cards.text: Villainous. While there is 4 threat here, treat Black Cat as an ally that takes 2 consequential damage after she attacks or thwarts. Hero Action: Spend a [mental] resource → place 1 threat here. If there is 4 threat here, take control of Black Cat as an ally.

cards.name: Diamondback
cards.text:
Villainous. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Diamondback attacks you, take 1 damage.
[star] Boost: Take 1 damage.

cards.name: Spot
cards.text: Enters play with 1 spot counter on him. Forced Interrupt: When Spot would be dealt damage from an attack, if there is at least 1 spot counter here, remove 1 spot counter from here and deal that damage to the attacker instead. Otherwise, place 1 spot counter here.

cards.name: Stilt-Man
cards.text: Enters play with 2 stilt counters on him. [star] Stilt-Man gets +1 SCH and +1 ATK for each stilt counter on him. Forced Interrupt: When Stilt-Man would take any amount of damage, remove 1 stilt counter from him instead.

cards.name: Kingpin's Influence
cards.text: When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme places 3 threat on their nemesis side scheme. If it is not in play, they find it and reveal it.

cards.name: Organized Crime
cards.text: Each minion gets +2 hit points.

cards.name: Bag of Tricks
cards.text:
When Revealed: Reveal a random card from your set-aside nemesis set. If no card is revealed this way, this card gains surge.
[star] Boost: Give this character a random card from your set-aside nemesis set as an additional boost card.

cards.name: Unrelenting Hate
cards.text:
When Revealed: Your nemesis minion activates against you. If your nemesis minion is not in play, find it and reveal it. If you cannot find it, find an [[Underling]] minion that is not in play and reveal it.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains overkill.

cards.name: Mystic Incursion
cards.text: Uses (2 civilian counters). Hero Action: Spend [mental] [mental] resources or exhaust a hero or ally you control → remove 1 civilian counter from here (2 counters instead if you exhausted a [[Mystic]] character).

cards.name: Sinking Ferry
cards.text: Uses (2 civilian counters). Hero Action: Spend [energy] [energy] resources or exhaust a hero or ally you control → remove 1 civilian counter from here (2 counters instead if you exhausted an [[Aerial]] character).

cards.name: Towering Inferno
cards.text: Uses (2 civilian counters). Hero Action: Spend [physical] [physical] resources or exhaust a hero or ally you control → remove 1 civilian counter from here (2 counters instead if you exhausted a character that has a tough status card).

cards.name: Collapsing Bridge
cards.text: [star] Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Response: After any amount of threat is removed from Collapsing Bridge, place 1 threat here.

cards.name: Bystanders in Peril
cards.text:
When Revealed: Place 1 civilian counter on a [[Disaster]] environment. If no counter was placed this way, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Disaster]] environment and reveal it.
[star] Boost: Place 1 civilian counter on a [[Disaster]] environment.

cards.name: Cop
cards.text: Quickstrike. Vulnerable. [star] Forced Interrupt: When Cop would scheme, it attacks the villain instead. When Defeated: Place 2 threat on the main scheme.

cards.name: Crooked Cop
cards.text:
Quickstrike. Vulnerable. When Defeated: The defeating player deals themself 1 facedown encounter card.
[star] Boost: Take 2 indirect damage.

cards.name: Wanted
cards.text: Hero Action: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a [[Police]] minion is discarded and put it into play engaged with you. Discard this card.

cards.name: Police Cordon
cards.text: [star] Hinder 1[per_hero]. Each [[Police]] minion gains guard and patrol. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Police]] minion and reveal it.

cards.name: Sports Car
cards.text: Attach to the enemy with the highest ATK without a [[Vehicle]] attachment. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. If there is 4 or more damage here, discard this card.

cards.name: Motorcycle
cards.text: Attach to the enemy with the highest SCH without a [[Vehicle]] attachment. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. If there is 3 or more damage here, discard this card.

cards.name: Utility Van
cards.text: Attach to the enemy with the fewest remaining hit points without a [[Vehicle]] attachment. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Forced Interrupt: When attached character would take any amount of damage, place it here instead. If there is 6 or more damage here, discard this card.

cards.name: Traffic Jam
cards.text: [star] Hinder 2[per_hero]. Forced Interrupt: When a character with a [[Vehicle]] attachment would: • Add threat to a scheme, that threat is added here instead. • Remove threat from a scheme, that threat is removed from here instead.

cards.name: Carjacking
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the encounter deck until a [[Vehicle]] attachment is discarded and reveal it. If your identity does not have a [[Vehicle]] attachment, you may spend 3 resources of the same type to attach the discarded attachment to your identity instead.

cards.name: Flight Serum
cards.text: Attach to a non-[[Aerial]] enemy. Otherwise, this card gains surge. Attached enemy gains [[Aerial]]. Hero Action: Discard an [[Attack]] event from your hand → discard this card.

cards.name: Mister Fish
cards.text: [star] Mister Fish’s attacks gain piercing and ranged. When Revealed: Mister Fish engages the player whose identity has the fewest remaining hit points.

cards.name: The Owl
cards.text:
Quickstrike. [star] The Owl’s attacks gain piercing.
[star] Boost: If this activation is an attack, it gains piercing.

cards.name: Swoop Down
cards.text: When Revealed (Alter-Ego): The villain and each minion engaged with you schemes. Each [[Aerial]] enemy gets +2 SCH for its activation. When Revealed (Hero): The villain and each minion engaged with you attacks you. Each [[Aerial]] enemy gets +2 ATK for its activation.

cards.name: Cold as Ice
cards.text: Attach to the minion with the highest base hit points and give that minion a tough status card. Otherwise, this card gains surge. [star] Forced Response: After attached minion schemes, confuse the first player’s identity and discard Cold as Ice.

cards.name: Hard as Marble
cards.text: Attach to the minion with the highest base hit points and give that minion a tough status card. Otherwise, this card gains surge. [star] Forced Response: After attached minion attacks, stun the attacked character and discard Hard as Marble.

cards.name: Beetle
cards.text: Villainous. When Revealed: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an attachment that can attach to a minion and attach it to Beetle.

cards.name: Tombstone
cards.text:
Quickstrike.
[star] Boost: Give the villain a tough status card.

cards.name: Hit List
cards.text: Forced Response: After the villain phase begins, deal 3 indirect damage to the first player. For each ally defeated this way, remove 1[per_hero] threat from Hit List.

cards.name: Ivan Banionis
cards.text: Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). When Revealed: Place 1 acceleration token here. [star] Forced Response: After Ivan Banionis schemes, place 1 acceleration token here.

cards.name: The Clown
cards.text: Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). Villainous. [star] Forced Response: After The Clown schemes, give him 1 facedown boost card.

cards.name: Tracksuit Mafioso
cards.text: Retaliate 2. Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). Vulnerable. When Defeated: Tuck this card under the Tracksuit Mafia side scheme. Otherwise, stun and confuse the character that defeated Tracksuit Mafioso.

cards.name: Tracksuit Bro
cards.text: Teamwork ([[Tracksuit]]). Vulnerable. When Defeated: Tuck this card under the Tracksuit Mafia side scheme. Otherwise, shuffle this card into the encounter deck.

cards.name: Tracksuit Mafia
cards.text: When Revealed: Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Tracksuit]] minion is discarded and tuck that minion here. Forced Response: After a player reveals a [[Tracksuit]] minion from the encounter deck, that player reveals 1 minion tucked here.

cards.name: Art Museum Heist
cards.text: Setup: Give each identity a tough status card.

cards.name: Art Museum Heist
cards.text: Setup: Each player chooses to stun or confuse their identity (in expert mode, do both instead).

cards.name: The Getaway
cards.text: Setup: After resolving mulligans, each player may search their deck and discard pile for an upgrade and add it to their hand. In expert mode, each player who did so discards 1 card from their hand.

cards.name: The Getaway
cards.text: In expert mode, attachments cannot be discarded from play during the first round. Setup: Each player searches the encounter deck for an attachment and reveals it. Deal a facedown encounter card to each player who could not.

cards.name: Protection Racket
cards.text: Setup: After resolving mulligans, each player may search their deck and discard pile for a support and add it to their hand. In expert mode, each player who did so discards 1 card from their hand.

cards.name: Protection Racket
cards.text: Setup: Each player chooses and discards 1 card from their hand (in expert mode, 2 cards instead).

cards.name: The Raft Breakout
cards.text: Setup: After resolving mulligans, each player may search their deck and discard pile for an ally and add it to their hand. In expert mode, each player who did so discards 1 card from their hand.

cards.name: The Raft Breakout
cards.text: Setup: Shuffle each minion in The Raft Breakout encounter set into the encounter deck (in expert mode, deal 1 of those minions at random to each player as a facedown encounter card before shuffling in the rest).

cards.name: Stop the Presses!
cards.text: Setup: Each player puts 1 [[Daily Bugle]] support (that has not been removed from the campaign) into play from the Stop the Presses! encounter set.

cards.name: Stop the Presses!
cards.text: Setup: Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card (in expert mode, 2 encounter cards instead).

cards.name: Typhoid Mary
cards.text: Setup. Victory −1. [star] Forced Response: After you reveal a minion, remove all damage from here and flip this card.

cards.name: Bloody Mary
cards.text: Victory −1. [star] Forced Response: After you reveal a side scheme, remove all damage from here and flip this card.
